syndromes.name: Bronchial Asthma Flare & Acute Bronchospasm
syndromes.description: Reversible hyperreactive airway obstruction triggered by allergens, viral infections, or cold air with wheeze and dyspnea.

lines.sig: 2 Puffs BD & 1-2 Puffs SOS for Reliever (GINA Track 1)

lines.drugLabel: Salbutamol + Budesonide Inhaler with Spacer & Mask

lines.sig: 14 mL (1 mg/kg/day for 14kg) Morning x 3 Days

syndromes.name: Acute Bronchitis with Productive Cough
syndromes.description: Lower respiratory tracheobronchial mucosal inflammation characterized by thick mucus production and paroxysmal coughing.

substitutions.drugAdult: Azithromycin 500mg OD x 3 Days or Doxycycline 100mg BD x 7 Days
substitutions.drugChild: Azithromycin 100mg/5ml Suspension (7 mL Day 1, then 3.5 mL Days 2-5)

syndromes.name: Acid Peptic Disease / GERD / Acute Dyspepsia
syndromes.description: Excessive gastric acid secretion, reflux esophagitis, or mucosal irritation responsive to proton pump blockade and prokinetics.

lines.sig: 10 mL 1 hr after meals & at bedtime SOS
10 mL QID 1 hr before meals & HS

syndromes.name: Acute Gastroenteritis / Diarrhea with Dehydration
syndromes.description: Acute diarrheal disease with fluid loss and electrolyte depletion secondary to viral or bacterial enteropathogens.

substitutions.drugChild: Cefixime Oral Suspension 100mg/5ml (4 mL BD x 5 Days)

syndromes.name: Essential Hypertension (Stage 1 & Stage 2)
syndromes.description: Persistent elevation of systemic arterial blood pressure requiring stepped guideline-directed vasodilatory and neurohormonal blockade.

lines.sig: Consult Pediatric Nephrologist strictly; 2.5mg OD if secondary HTN confirmed

syndromes.name: Musculoskeletal Pain, Lumbago & Acute Sprain
syndromes.description: Acute somatic pain and muscular spasm secondary to ligamentous strain, mechanical injury, or localized inflammatory response.

lines.purpose: NSAID, Analgesic & Centrally Acting Muscle Relaxant

lines.sig: Apply gently to painful area TID
Apply cold pack for 15 min TID

substitutions.reason: Avoids COX-1 mediated bronchospasm and anaphylaxis

syndromes.name: Acute Upper Respiratory Infection (URI) / Tonsillopharyngitis
syndromes.description: Acute viral or bacterial inflammation of the upper respiratory tract presenting with throat pain, pyrexia, and catarrhal symptoms.

substitutions.drugChild: Azithromycin Oral Suspension 100mg/5ml (7 mL Day 1, then 3.5 mL Days 2-5)

syndromes.name: Uncomplicated Urinary Tract Infection (Cystitis)
syndromes.description: Acute bacterial mucosal proliferation in the bladder and lower urinary tract commonly caused by uropathogenic E. coli.

lines.sig: 15 mL in a glass of water TID

substitutions.drugAdult: Fosfomycin Trometamol 3g Single Dose Sachet in water or Cefuroxime 500mg BD x 5 Days
substitutions.reason: Safe alternative with high urinary excretion

rules.subject: Penicillin

rules.message: SEVERE RENAL IMPAIRMENT: eGFR < 30 mL/min. Metformin accumulation provokes fatal lactic acidosis; Nitrofurantoin is ineffective and neurotoxic.
